resources.string: Device Offline
Make sure the device is powered on and connected to the same local network, then try again.
Local Network Unavailable
Connect this phone to the same local network as the device, then try again.
Device Authentication Required
This device must be paired with your account again before its controls can be opened.
Device Could Not Be Reached
The device is visible on the local network but did not answer the current control check. Keep it powered on and try again.
Device State Could Not Be Verified
The device connection is available, but its current control state could not be verified safely. Try again.
Device Unavailable
This device is not available in the current account. Refresh your devices or add it again.
Unsupported Device
This device model or hardware profile is not supported by this AquaLight build.
Device Software Incompatible
The device is online, but its firmware control contract is not compatible with this app build. Check for a firmware or app update before using device controls.
Device State Could Not Be Verified
The device is online, but its current software state could not be validated safely. Device controls were not opened.
Feature Not Available
This feature is not available on the device’s current software. Other compatible device controls remain available.
Firmware Update Required
A firmware update is required to use this feature. Other compatible device controls remain available.
App Update Required
The device is online, but it uses a newer protocol than this app supports. Update the AquaLight app to continue.
